instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. In an indoor studio with pink, purple, and blue lighting, a group dances. On the left, the man in the denim jacket (R4) dances looking down. In the center, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) strikes a pose with her arms raised, looking at the camera. Behind her, the man in the white t-shirt (R2) is partially visible. On the right, the black woman in the red fringed dress (R1) dances, looking forward.
